spec: GOAL: a paste-and-read monthly report workbook. Sheets (Korean names): 00_사용법 (3-step guide, colour legend: yellow=input, grey=formula/do-not-edit, light-blue=result; warning to DELETE buyer name/phone/address columns before pasting; unofficial notice; AI-disclosure sentence; disclaimer: calculation aid only); 01_주문데이터 (columns: 주문일, 상품명, 옵션(선택), 수량, 결제금액, 채널(자유입력), 취소/반품여부 [Y/N]; NO personal-data columns; user pastes own data in this order; do NOT claim compatibility with any platform export); 02_광고데이터 (일자, 광고비, 노출, 클릭, 광고주문수, 광고매출); 03_상품목록 (user types up to 50 product names; do NOT use UNIQUE/SORT/dynamic arrays); 04_지표요약 with 6 KPI groups: (1) 총매출 = SUMIFS(결제금액, 취소/반품여부,'N'), 주문 수 = COUNTIFS, 객단가 = 총매출/주문 수; (2) 상품별 매출 TOP5 via SUMIFS per product + LARGE/INDEX-MATCH with a tie-break helper column; (3) 요일별 매출 via helper WEEKDAY column; (4) 취소/반품률; (5) 광고 CPC, 전환율 (광고주문/클릭); (6) ROAS = 광고매출/광고비; charts: daily revenue line, weekday bar, TOP5 bar, ROAS trend (openpyxl charts); 05_해석메모 (fill-in-the-blank prompts only, NO auto-generated conclusions); 06_계산식설명 (every formula explained in plain Korean, so the owner can explain it); 07_샘플데이터(가상) (about 300 synthetic rows for one month + ad rows, fixed random seed, labeled 'sample, synthetic data'). FUNCTIONS: SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, SUMPRODUCT, INDEX/MATCH, LARGE, WEEKDAY, IFERROR, TEXT only; no LET/LAMBDA/XLOOKUP/dynamic arrays; no macros (.xlsx), no external links, no hidden sheets. All divisions wrapped to show a friendly message instead of errors. BUILD: openpyxl or XlsxWriter script kept in build_notes. ACCEPTANCE: AC-01 LibreOffice headless recalculation leaves 0 error cells (#REF!,#DIV/0!,#NAME?,#VALUE!,#N/A) in every sheet; AC-02 the 6 KPI groups on the synthetic data equal a pandas reference computation (amounts +-1 KRW, ratios +-0.01 pp); AC-03 edge inputs (0 orders, empty ad sheet, 0 clicks, blank rows, unregistered product) show guidance text not errors; AC-04 no macros, 0 external links (link list empty), 0 hidden sheets, 0 personal-data columns; AC-05 owner opens in real Windows Excel without warnings, 4 charts render, no broken Korean; AC-06 every guide screenshot matches the final file (if captured from LibreOffice, say so in build_notes and let the owner decide to recapture 2 images in Excel); AC-07 every capability claimed in listing.md is demonstrable in the file. LISTING: title style '월간 매출·광고 성과 리포트 템플릿 (엑셀, 붙여넣으면 핵심 지표 6개 계산)'; sections: what you get (sheet list), requirements (Excel 2016+ or Google Sheets upload), before/after preview, FAQ, AI-disclosure sentence 'AI 도구를 활용해 제작하고 제작자가 직접 검수·테스트했습니다', digital-file refund text per 크몽 base wording (no blanket 환불 불가). FORBIDDEN CLAIMS: revenue/ROAS improvement, 'auto analysis' hype, platform export compatibility, superlatives (최고/최대/유일), external contacts, income figures, AI-generated people. DISCLAIMER on platform names: used descriptively only, unofficial, no logos or UI captures. Owner can reach any file defect within 24h answer time. PORTFOLIO USE: the service DELUXE sample report is produced from this template's synthetic data.

title: 엑셀·CSV 여러 파일 병합·정리 파이썬 스크립트 키트 (소스 제공, 설정 파일로 규칙 지정, exe 없음)
model: Chosen model A (digital file, script kit) and portfolio piece for service STANDARD; wave A
format: .zip: merge_excel.py (single script, pandas+openpyxl), config.example.json, requirements.txt (pinned, tested versions), samples/ (5 synthetic messy xlsx/csv sets + golden outputs), README (Korean, Windows beginner install/run guide, PDF copy), tests/, LICENSE_TERMS.txt, THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt, CHANGELOG.md
target_platform: 크몽 (자료·템플릿; sub-category confirmed on registration screen)
target_buyer: Office workers, sellers and learners who can install Python (first line of the listing says 'Python 설치가 필요합니다')
deliverables: SHA-256 of the zip (recorded in READY_FOR_OWNER.md)
spec: GOAL: reusable merge/cleanup of many Excel/CSV files into one table. NO exe, NO PyInstaller/UPX (R20). BEHAVIOUR: reads every .xlsx/.csv in an input folder (state only tested formats); never modifies originals; config.json controls file pattern, sheet selection, header row position, column-name mapping (different labels to one), whitespace/case normalization, date-format unification, duplicate-removal key columns, output file name; appends '원본파일' and '원본시트' columns; writes merged.xlsx (optional csv) and merge_report.txt (rows read, duplicates dropped, files skipped with reason); CSV encoding auto-try utf-8, utf-8-sig, cp949 with a clear Korean error on failure; Korean error messages and FAQ (install failure, encoding error, file open in Excel). SAMPLES: 5 deliberately messy synthetic sets (header row at different positions, different column labels, mixed date formats, exact duplicate rows, empty rows/columns, a cp949 CSV) plus golden output files. ACCEPTANCE: AC-01 fresh Windows venv: pip install -r requirements.txt, run on samples, output equals golden file cell by cell; AC-02 unit tests pass (header variants, encodings, duplicates, empty input, missing folder, file locked/open); AC-03 zero network calls: AST import scan plus tests run with sockets blocked; ONLY after this passes may the listing say 'data stays on your PC'; AC-04 secrets/absolute-path/personal-string scan = 0; dependency licences checked (pandas BSD-3, openpyxl MIT, numpy BSD, etc.), no GPL code, recorded in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt; AC-05 LICENSE_TERMS: personal/in-house use allowed, no redistribution/resale, no warranty, no 'exclusive copyright' wording (AI output is protected only where human creative contribution exists); AC-06 zip SHA-256 recorded and shown in the listing; AC-07 Korean README lets a beginner go from install to first merged file. LISTING: show before/after sample, state honestly that free alternatives exist (e.g. Excel Power Query) and what this offers (rules in a config file, repeatable runs), requirements (Windows, Python 3.x install steps included), AI-disclosure sentence, refund text per 크몽 base wording. FORBIDDEN: 'no antivirus warning' promises, speed guarantees, claims of safe handling of personal data, superlatives, income claims, external contacts. SERVICE LINK: this script is the base of the STANDARD service deliverable and evidence of Python-automation skill; owner must be able to explain every step of the script.

spec: PACKAGES: STANDARD (30,000): up to 3 files merged/cleaned, one cleanup rule set (column unification / duplicate removal / format unification, pick 1-2), output xlsx + short usage note, 1 revision, delivery 3 business days. DELUXE (80,000): STANDARD + summary sheet + 6 key metrics + charts + one-page interpretation memo (PDF or Excel) + re-runnable script source with README, 2 revisions, delivery 5 business days. NO PREMIUM (scheduled run, Google Sheets integration, dashboards, deployment need client credentials/hosting = R14). Revision rule aligned with 크몽 terms (revision request within 7 days of receipt; further revisions may be declined once the listed scope is fulfilled). Delivery days are concrete business days (no vague timing). Refund wording is at least the legal minimum. NOT PROVIDED (state in listing and intake): files with personal data (buyer names/phones/addresses/accounts), login-required collection, crawling of Naver/Coupang/SNS etc., thesis/assignment statistics, client passwords/API keys/server access, monthly maintenance or incident response, accuracy/security/business-outcome guarantees, legal/tax/medical/investment judgement, hosting/deployment. CRAWLING IS OUT of the first wave; wave 2 may add a separate listing limited to client-owned/authorised pages, official open APIs, or pages whose robots.txt and ToS allow it (R15). WORKFLOW (document it): client file stays on the owner PC; AI only sees schema, masked sample or synthetic data; a separate verifier agent tests on synthetic data; owner runs on the real file locally, must be able to explain every formula/script (else decline/do not deliver), then clicks 'send deliverable'; client personal data discovered = stop, tell client, delete; client files deleted within 30 days after 구매확정 with a log. CAPACITY: max 3 new orders per month; reply within 24h via one fixed 10-minute daily window + auto-reply; use 휴가 모드 when away; below 4 h/week run at most this one service. UNIT ECONOMICS: STANDARD nets about 23,490; at 2-3 owner hours that is about 7.8-11.7k KRW/h, i.e. at or below the 2026 minimum wage (10,320, re-check) so STANDARD is a deliberate entry tier capped at 3 orders; log owner hours per order. LISTING LINT (must pass): no 최고/최초/유일/무제한 A/S, no external contacts/links, no '견적 별도 협의', no unproven credentials or awards, no income or result promises, no AI-generated people, samples never attributed to a client; owner introduced honestly as a learner with a verifiable portfolio; AI sentence: 'AI 도구를 활용해 제작하고 제작자가 직접 검수·테스트했습니다' (never claim hand-made or no-AI). PRICE RATIONALE cites 크몽 guides (Excel avg about 70k, data preprocessing avg 120k+, performance report 150-400k, 2025-09, platform self-published, methodology undisclosed) and fee math; state that net excludes income tax/insurance. PREREQUISITES before the owner submits: Day-0 gate passed, written 크몽 1:1 AI answer saved, 사업자등록 by first paid order (default), no AI-generated profile/thumbnail people, 크몽 profile-evidence rules (posts 753/754) read. ACCEPTANCE: AC-01 compliance STATUS CLEAR/CONDITIONAL; AC-02 lint 0 violations; AC-03 the 3 portfolio samples open and are labeled; AC-04 refusal rules visible on intake page one; AC-05 price rationale and fee math correct; AC-06 AI-disclosure sentence present and truthful.

title: 온라인 셀러 채널별 순마진·손익분기 계산기 (엑셀·구글시트 겸용, 매크로 없음, 수수료율 직접 입력)

format: .xlsx + usage guide PDF 8-10 pages + preview images + 3 synthetic sample sets with hand-computed answers

spec: PRECONDITION: the owner pastes titles/prices/review counts/seller transaction counts of the top 10 similar 크몽 listings into competitors.md (the AI never crawls 크몽). Known: at least 5 similar listings and free calculators exist and fee defaults differ between sources, so ALL fee rates are input cells. SHEETS: 00_사용법 (3 steps, colour legend, fee 기준일 explanation, unofficial + AI-disclosure notices, disclaimer); 01_설정 (3 channels with editable names default '채널1/2/3'; per channel 판매수수료율, 결제수수료율, 기타수수료율, 건당 고정수수료, toggle whether entered rates already include VAT, 수수료율 기준일, memo cell for the official page checked; global target net margin, default packaging cost, seller-borne return shipping; defaults blank, example values appear only in the sample sheet and are labeled as examples); 02_단건계산 (inputs: product name, price, cost, seller-paid shipping, customer-paid shipping received, packaging, coupon/discount, ad cost per order or % of price, return rate, return-loss model = round-trip shipping + non-resellable share x cost, channel dropdown; outputs: total fees, net profit per order = price - coupon - fees - cost - packaging - net shipping - ad - expected return loss, net margin %, break-even price in closed form = (fixed per-order costs) / (1 - fee% - ad% - coupon%), price needed for target margin, profit/loss flag); 03_SKU비교 (30 rows, same inputs/outputs, loss rows in red via conditional formatting); 04_채널비교 (one product across 3 channels); 05_광고손익분기 (break-even ROAS = 1 / pre-ad margin, max CPA, max CPC given conversion rate); 06_계산식설명 (plain Korean explanation of every formula so the owner can explain it); 07_샘플3세트(가상) (3 scenarios with hand-computed correct answers). The pm must write the exact formulas before building. ACCEPTANCE: AC-01 LibreOffice recalculation: 0 error cells; AC-02 3 samples + 10 random cases equal a Python reference within 1 KRW; AC-03 edge cases (price 0, price < cost, ad 100%, return rate 100%, fee blank) show guidance text; AC-04 no macros, external links, hidden sheets, personal data, hard-coded fee rates; AC-05 only Excel 2016/Google Sheets common functions (IFERROR, INDEX, MATCH, SUMPRODUCT...), no LET/LAMBDA/XLOOKUP; AC-06 owner hand-checks one sample in real Excel. LISTING: claim only verifiable differentiators (return-loss model, ad break-even, target-margin price, 30-SKU comparison). FORBIDDEN: 'compatible with 스마트스토어/쿠팡 settlement files', 'fees applied automatically', margin guarantees, logos/UI screenshots, superlatives. Platform names used descriptively with 'unofficial, no affiliation' notice. Build only one margin calculator in the whole plan (no variants in first 60 days).

title: 1인 사업자·프리랜서 월간 수입·경비 기록 장부 (집계 전용, 세율·신고 안내 없음, 매크로 없음)
model: Chosen model A (digital file, recording only); wave B (last to publish, after day 60)
format: .xlsx + usage guide PDF 6-8 pages + preview images + synthetic sample data
target_buyer: Freelancers and one-person businesses who need to record income, expenses and platform settlements
deliverables: sample (synthetic 30 rows incl. 3 deliberately mismatched settlement rows)
spec: IDENTITY: recording and totalling only. NO tax rates, NO filing instructions, NO refund/saving claims, NO tax conclusions, NO 'prepare for 종합소득세 신고' framing, no export sheet marketed for a tax accountant (크몽 bars unlicensed 세무사-type services; withholding-rate change 3.3%->2.2% is unconfirmed). Every guide page footer and the listing say: '이 파일은 기록과 합계를 위한 도구이며 세무 자문이 아닙니다.' SHEETS: 00_사용법; 01_설정 (year; user-editable lists for expense categories, counterparties/platforms, evidence types); 02_거래입력 (1,000 rows, data validation; columns: 날짜, 구분[수입/경비], 플랫폼·거래처, 항목, 카테고리, 총액, 플랫폼 수수료, 원천징수액 [user enters the value shown on the settlement statement], 실입금액, 증빙유형, 메모; computed columns: 예상입금액 = 총액 - 수수료 - 원천징수액, 차이 = 실입금액 - 예상입금액); 03_월별요약 (12 months via SUMIFS: income, fees, withholding shown separately, expenses, net, count); 04_정산대사 (rows whose 차이 is not 0, with count and sum); 05_거래처별; 06_카테고리별; 07_샘플(가상); 08_계산식설명. The owner must actually use it for his own 크몽 settlement reconciliation (real use, real or synthetic entries) before selling; never write experience that did not happen. ACCEPTANCE: AC-01 LibreOffice recalculation 0 error cells; AC-02 sample sums equal a Python reference; AC-03 lint finds 0 tax-rate, filing-advice, 환급/절세 expressions in file, guide or listing; AC-04 no macros, external links, personal data; AC-05 the reconciliation sheet flags exactly the 3 deliberately mismatched sample rows; AC-06 no listing text implying tax filing help. Price designed with VAT in mind (ISBN-less files are widely treated as taxable; confirm with 세무사). Competes with free 국세청 간편장부, so the only claimed differentiator is the settlement-reconciliation sheet. Expected sales near 0, which is why it ships last.
